newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss restate 1995 GDP to up 0.8 pct vs 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss restate 1995 GDP to up 0.8 pct vs 0.1 pct.

text.p: Switzerland's new method of compiling economic data shows 1995 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew a real 0.8 percent rather than the 0.1 percent growth reported under the old system, the Federal Statistics Office said.
The change reflects adaptations that now put Switzerland in line with the prevailing economic reporting system in Europe, the office said in a statement.
It did not provide restated data for 1996.
